entries.note: The first row of the public example, at the Customer Care Center: the shipper booked the pickup, before the driver has the freight.
The driver collected the freight at the origin town.
The trailer left a terminal for the one the wording names, such as Seattle or the Vantage meet point.
The trailer reached the next terminal; the public example's row gives In Transit as its place.
The public example lists it twice: at the delivery's time, and on the day of the proof of delivery without a time.
